Add the rice and bring back to the boil. Reduce the heat and cover tightly.
Pour the syrup into the pan, bring to a boil, then lower the heat for five minutes.
quiet: Pour in the broth, add the herbs, then stir and taste for salt.
When the soup is ready, ladle it into warm bowls and serve.
Add the lentils and water. Stir in the spices and the chopped garlic.
Stir in the tomatoes and the basil, then season with salt and pepper.
Cover the potatoes with foil and set them aside until you need them.
Once the milk is cold, pour it into a jug for the table.
Add the rice and the peas. Fluff with a fork and serve warm.
Pour the syrup into a jar, close the lid, then keep it in the fridge.
